visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of two sliced Vienna bread rolls with vibrant green matcha filling on a white decorative plate. In the background, a stack of plain bread rolls sits on another white tray near a window with blinds. (2) The scene shifts to hands kneading dough on a white marble surface; a digital scale and an orange bench scraper are visible in the background. (3) The creator's hands roll the dough into smooth balls and then use a white textured rolling pin to flatten and shape them into long logs, carefully folding the edges. (4) A close-up shows a small knife scoring diagonal lines across the top of the dough logs which are laid out on a baking tray with parchment paper. (5) After proofing, the bread is shown again in the tray, followed by a shot of the golden-brown baked bread being removed from the oven with a grey checkered mitt. (6) A blue food processor is used to blend matcha powder and white cream into a smooth filling; subsequently, red beans are stirred into the mixture in a small glass jar. (7) A baked roll is sliced open and the matcha-red bean cream is spread generously inside with a spatula. (8) The finished bread is wrapped in clear plastic bags tied with pink bows, and the video concludes with the packaged products displayed on the counter.
